subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Mixed generic runtime object helpers in the 0x004A0000-0x004B1000 range: a session-state global block (state setter, one-way flag, restart reset), a single-instance OS-manager mutex guard, a vtable-dispatch linked-list iterator, a min/max inverse-range proportion initializer, a pit-crew mesh/animation object family with array growth and orientation math, generic struct init/cleanup stubs, a championship threshold notifier, a large aggregate destructor, save-file copy with metadata append, track-environment and damage-part-state setup, path string utilities, and the player-file load chain.

summary: Reconstruction of the generic runtime-object helpers in the packet address range 0x004A0D30-0x004B0540. The functions group into: (1) a SessionStateManager over a compact global block (byte_7CE254 state with guard-on-change reset of dword_7CE250, one-way set-only flag byte_7CE25D, and a five-global restart reset); (2) an OSManagerSingleton that builds a named CreateMutexA single-instance guard and logs entry; (3) a LinkedListIterator that walks a node chain and dispatches each node's first vtable entry with (node, arg) plus an optional dual-path resource lookup; (4) a RangeProportion initializer storing min/max and the precomputed inverse range with a zero-width guard; (5) a PitCrewMeshObject family (mode/parameter setter, string-to-loader forwarding with a trailing flag byte, animation-frame array append with header-counted growth, and a two-vector copy into 0x4C-0x60 that dispatches to the 3D layer) plus a PitCrewMemberOrientation helper that converts Euler angles and applies a 180-degree Y rotation; (6) a UIComponent set of base/ext struct init and cleanup stubs; (7) free StringUtils and PathUtilities helpers (quote stripping, path truncation, last-backslash extraction); (8) a ChampionshipThresholdNotifier that fires a state change when the player score plus one crosses a stride-2 threshold array; (9) a LargeAggregateObject bulk destructor with fixed-count descending free loops and a singly-linked node walk; (10) a SaveFileUtility appending a metadata block to the destination filename; (11) TrackEnvironmentSetup selecting the environment variant, clamping the camera index, loading the track scene, and running the physics/driving-mode/visibility/tire-compound chain, plus InitDamagePartState writing paired flag/type-ID part tables per mode; and (12) a PlayerFileLoader chain (directory check, then the audio-stream-gated init chain ending in the active-vehicle array and autoload entries). All class boundaries and field names are DERIVED or GUESS proposals on top of packet evidence; raw source and validated IR outrank worker synthesis.

function_roles.role: Session-state setter: capture input byte a1, and only when it differs from the current global byte_7CE254 write it to byte_7CE254 and reset dword_7CE250 to 0; always return the requested state byte.
One-way session flag setter: unconditionally write 1 to byte_7CE25D and return; no guards, arguments or clearing counterpart.
Session-state restart reset: zero dword_7CE250, dword_7CE258, byte_7CE260, byte_7CE269 and dword_7CE26C, then return 0; part of the Game_Restart path.

Single-instance guard: conditionally log OS-manager entry after StringSplitLoop(2, build-version string, 420), create a named mutex (global hObject = CreateMutexA(0, 1, Name)), and return TRUE when the mutex already exists (GetLastError() == 183) or creation failed (null handle); FALSE only when this instance created and owns it.

Linked-list dispatch with vtable calls: optionally run the dual-path resource lookup (0x00566CF0) when a3 is non-zero, reset the iterator to the head (this+0x8 = this+0x0), and walk the chain calling each node's first vtable entry with (node, a2); return the last visited node or null.

Range proportion initializer: store a2 as the range minimum (field 0x0) and a3 as the maximum (field 0x4), then precompute 1/(a3-a2) into field 0x8 when the width is positive, else 0.0; used to set up min/max/inverse-range triples before per-frame proportion lookups.

Mesh-load forwarding stub: copy the input string into a 68-byte local buffer, append the constant flag byte 1 at index 64, then call PitCrewMeshLoader(this, a2, buffer, a4, a5) and return its result; no reversal operation appears in this body despite the legacy name.

Pit-crew animation frame append: grow the 28-byte element array (4-byte count header plus this[28]+1 elements), construct new slots, copy the old elements from this+0x74, destroy and free the old array, then populate the new last element's scratch buffer per entry (string-handle conversion, wide-string list walk) and increment the element count only when every entry is populated; log a cube loading error on an early break.

Mode-dependent pit-crew mesh load: store a mode byte at this+0x2 and a DWORD parameter at this+0x48, load the mesh via PitCrewMeshLoader(this, a4, a5, a6, 0), then when the guard at this+0x64 is non-zero run FlagFieldBitManipulation with (1,1,0,0) when the mode byte is non-zero else (0,0,0,0) and return its result.
Two-vector copy: copy a2 into this+0x4C/0x50/0x54 and a3 into this+0x58/0x5C/0x60, then forward the updated data to the 3D subsystem via ConditionalDispatch_27d0(this) and return its result.
Struct field reinitialization stub: zero this+0xC, this+0x10 and this+0x14, then call ArrayResourceCleanup (0x004A29A0) to release prior array resources before the object is reused; return this.
Quote-stripping copy: copy the source string into the output buffer skipping every double-quote character (0x22), null-terminate the compacted result, and return the outcome of sub_589901(lpSrcStr).

Pit-crew member orientation setup: guarded by this[5] (offset +0x14); when non-zero convert Euler angles a3 to a rotation matrix, build a 180-degree Y-axis rotation (pi), forward the three transform fields from a2 via ThreeFieldSetterWithSubCall, apply the Y rotation through sub_54B450, set the state flag this[2] (offset +0x8) to 2, and return the sub_54B450 result.
Extended struct initializer: zero the four consecutive DWORDs at this+0x78, this+0x7C, this+0x80 and this+0x84, then call sub_4A2220(this) unconditionally and return its result.
Large buffer zero-init: memset(this, 0, 0x1A0u) clears the 416-byte buffer at this and returns 0; called from the startup init path.

Five-sub-struct initializer: run StructInitializer on five consecutive 0x40-byte sub-structures starting at this[6] and advancing by 16 dwords, zero this+0xC/0x10/0x14, then call UIComponentCleanup(this) and return this; part of physics tire system construction.

Championship threshold notifier: in a championship session (dword_7C56A4 == 7), when the enable flag at obj+0x4040 is non-zero and at least one threshold entry exists (this+0x160 > 0), check whether the player score plus one (obj+0x403C) matches any even-indexed entry of the stride-2 array at this+0x164 and, on a match, call StateChangeNotify(this, 1); returns void.

Bulk destructor/cleanup for a large aggregate: clean a double-linked-list region, free arrays of 36-byte two-pointer structs in fixed-count descending loops, run a short-field cleanup helper over scattered offsets, free multi-pointer structs, walk the singly-linked list anchored at this+0 freeing each node and its payload, and zero the four head DWORDs.

Save-file copy with metadata: build the source path from a directory global (dword_5EC440, falling back to byte_5EA438) plus a resource-name string, truncate the destination path to 238 characters, append a metadata block (four dwords plus one word at the end of the destination filename), copy with CopyFileA and return its BOOL result.

Track environment select and physics setup: when a2 is set select the environment variant through sub_4AE750 using the byte_7CB710 / byte_7CBB0C flag bits, otherwise record the environment flag at this[1723]; clamp the camera index this[1732] into the [this[1734], this[1735]] range after stepping dword_5EC4A8 + 1 up to 4; load the track scene via TrackSceneLoader; then run the physics, driving-mode, car-part-visibility, sub_4AE9F0 and tire-compound setup chain, returning the TireCompoundClamp result.

Damage/part-state initializer driven by a clamped mode selector: clamp a2 between this+0x1AF4/this+0x1AF8, store it at this+0x1AEC, then write paired flag/part-type-ID fields at this+0x3670..0x3A2C according to the mode (cases 1/2/3 differ in enabled parts and type IDs) plus a tire-grip multiplier this+0x49C (0.6f) for mode 1, and apply a second block of 19 flag(0)+ID pairs whenever the selector is nonzero; returns 0.

Path truncation at the last directory separator: validate both arguments, copy the input into a 512-byte scratch buffer under a bounded copy, force-terminate at the caller limit, then clear bytes walking backward from the end of the string until a backslash (ASCII 92) is found; returns 0 on success, -1 on null arguments.

Last-backslash extractor: read the source string from this[109] (offset 0x1B4) falling back to global byte_5EA438 when null, scan backward to the last backslash, copy the trailing filename component into a2 via the bounded copy with limit a3-1, null-terminate, and return 1.

Directory-checked dispatch into player-file init: copy the input string into the internal buffer at this+20, select the target directory (dword_5EC440, falling back to byte_5EA438), verify it against the copied path with sub_566810 and rebuild the full path via sub_4B01B0 when the check fails, then call PlayerFileInit(a3) and return its result.

Player-file load/init: mark this+0x114 read-only when the file attribute bit 0 is set, open an audio stream on the object path (this+20) and on success run the full chain: mode-variant init (sub_4AE750), linked-list walk, normalization of this+0x1F00, clamping of this+0x2F8C by the two condition flags, scene-data parse, gate-adjusted count stored to dword_5C329C (forced 0 in game mode 5), active-vehicle array build, 5-step init, autoload entry loading, and a path-scoped computation into dword_5EA5E8; return 0 on success and -1 when the stream cannot be opened.

classes.name: SessionStateManager
classes.responsibility: Owns a compact session-state global block: a guarded state byte that resets a companion counter on change, a one-way set-only flag, and a five-global restart reset.

classes.name: OSManagerSingleton
classes.responsibility: Single-instance guard that creates a named mutex with initial ownership and reports whether this instance is the sole owner or already-running/failed.

classes.name: LinkedListIterator
classes.responsibility: Walks a linked list of nodes from the head at this+0x0, keeps a cursor at this+0x8, and dispatches each node's first vtable entry with (node, arg); optionally runs a dual-path resource lookup first.

classes.name: RangeProportion
classes.responsibility: Stores a float min/max range pair and the precomputed inverse range used for linear proportion lookups, guarding against empty or inverted ranges.

classes.name: PitCrewMeshObject
classes.responsibility: Pit-crew mesh/animation object: carries a mode byte at +0x2, a parameter at +0x48, two copied vectors at +0x4C-0x60, an init guard at +0x64, per-frame entry count at +0x68, a 28-byte element array count at +0x70 and its pointer at +0x74; loads meshes, appends animation frames with header-counted growth, and forwards updated vectors to the 3D layer.

fields.name: init_guard
fields.type_guess: int (non-zero means the object is initialized)

classes.name: PitCrewMemberOrientation
classes.responsibility: Per-member orientation setup: gated by an activation field at +0x14, converts Euler angles to a rotation matrix, applies a 180-degree Y rotation, forwards a transform, and records a state flag at +0x8.

classes.name: UIComponent
classes.responsibility: Generic UI/pit component struct lifecycle: base fields at +0xC/0x10/0x14 and extended fields at +0x78..0x84 are zeroed during init/cleanup, with array-resource cleanup and a five-sub-struct initializer for the physics tire system.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.responsibility: Free string-processing helper: quote-stripping copy that compacts a string by removing double-quote characters.

classes.name: ChampionshipThresholdNotifier
classes.responsibility: In a championship session, monitors whether the player score plus one crosses an entry of a stride-2 threshold array and fires a state-change notification on a match.

fields.name: threshold_array
fields.type_guess: int* (stride-2 threshold entries, even indices compared)

classes.name: LargeAggregateObject
classes.responsibility: Large aggregate container with a bulk destructor: cleans a double-linked-list region, frees fixed-count arrays of two-pointer/multi-pointer structs in descending loops, runs a short-field cleanup over scattered offsets, and walks a singly-linked list anchored at this+0.

fields.name: list_anchor_dword_0
fields.type_guess: int (singly-linked list head DWORD, zeroed after walk)

fields.name: list_anchor_dword_1
fields.type_guess: int (list head DWORD, zeroed after walk)

fields.name: list_anchor_dword_2
fields.type_guess: int (list head DWORD, zeroed after walk)

fields.name: list_anchor_dword_3
fields.type_guess: int (list head DWORD, zeroed after walk)

fields.name: list_node_anchor
fields.type_guess: void* (node reached from the list anchor at this+0)

fields.name: node_in_use_byte
fields.type_guess: byte (in-use marker read during the walk)

classes.name: SaveFileUtility
classes.responsibility: Copies a save/settings file and appends a four-dword-plus-one-word metadata block to the destination filename, truncating the destination path and building the source path from directory and resource-name globals.

classes.name: TrackEnvironmentSetup
classes.responsibility: Track environment selection and setup record: selects the environment variant or records a flag, clamps the camera index into a bound range, and drives the physics/driving-mode/visibility/tire-compound chain; also holds the clamped damage/part-state mode selector and the paired flag/type-ID part tables plus the tire-grip multiplier.

fields.name: environment_mode
fields.type_guess: int (environment variant flag / clamped mode selector)

fields.name: mode_bound_min
fields.type_guess: int (clamp lower bound for the mode selector)

fields.name: mode_bound_max
fields.type_guess: int (clamp upper bound for the mode selector)

classes.name: PathUtilities
classes.responsibility: Free path string helpers: truncate an in-place path buffer at its last backslash directory separator, and extract the trailing filename component after the last backslash.

classes.name: PlayerFileLoader
classes.responsibility: Loads and initializes a player file: carries the file path buffer at +0x14, a read-only marker at +0x114, the scene-data path at +0x138, a path string at +0x1B4, normalization and game-mode fields, and condition-flag clamp state; opens an audio stream and runs the full init chain on success.

fields.name: read_only_flag
fields.type_guess: int (set to 1 when the file attribute read-only bit is set)

fields.name: scene_data_path
fields.type_guess: char* (path passed to the scene data parser)

fields.name: path_string
fields.type_guess: char* (path consumed by the path-scoped computation and the last-backslash extractor)

fields.name: normalized_flag
fields.type_guess: int (normalized to its truth value during load)

fields.name: game_mode
fields.type_guess: int (mode used to index the gate-adjusted table; value 5 forces the count to 0)

fields.name: condition_flag_b
fields.type_guess: byte (clamps this+0x2F8C to a floor of 33 when set)

fields.name: condition_flag_a
fields.type_guess: byte (clamps this+0x2F8C to a floor of 34 when set)

fields.name: clamp_value
fields.type_guess: int (clamped to 33 or 34 by the condition flags)

transitions.on: player score plus one equals an even-indexed entry of the stride-2 threshold array (enable flag and element count guards pass)

interfaces.name: VTableNodeDispatch
interfaces.purpose: Walks a linked list starting at this+0x0 and invokes each node's first vtable entry (vtable[0]) with (node, arg); the second vtable entry is read but unused. A replacement iterator must reproduce the per-node dispatch and the cursor advance.

interfaces.name: PitCrewMeshLoaderBackend
interfaces.purpose: The external pit-crew mesh loader consumed by the mesh object: called with this, forwarding arguments, a 68-byte local buffer with a trailing flag byte, and two pass-through arguments; also called from the mode-dependent load with a zero fifth argument.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionStateGlobalBlockContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The session-state block must preserve: a state byte at 0x007CE254 that is only written when it differs from the requested byte and resets the counter at 0x007CE250 to 0 on change, a set-only flag at 0x007CE25D, and a restart reset that zeroes 0x007CE250, 0x007CE258, 0x007CE260, 0x007CE269 and 0x007CE26C. A replacement must reproduce the guard-on-change write and the five-global restart zeroing.

compatibility_contracts.name: SingleInstanceMutexContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The OS manager must create a named mutex with initial ownership requested and report: TRUE when the mutex already exists (GetLastError() == 183) or the handle is null (creation failed), FALSE only when this instance created and owns it. A replacement must preserve the exclusive-ownership detection and the ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS gate.

compatibility_contracts.name: PitCrewAnimationArrayGrowthContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Appending an animation frame must grow the element array as a 4-byte count header plus N elements of 28 bytes, default-construct each new slot, copy the existing elements from this+0x74, destroy the old elements in reverse order and free the old array with its header, and increment the element count at this+0x70 only when every entry was populated. A partial population must not count as a new element.

compatibility_contracts.name: PlayerFileLoadChainContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Loading a player file must open an audio stream on the path buffer at this+20 and return -1 when it cannot be opened, return 0 on success, mark this+0x114 read-only when the file attribute read-only bit is set, and on success run the init chain including the gate-adjusted count stored to dword_5C329C (forced to 0 in game mode 5), the active-vehicle pointer array build, and the autoload entry loading.

compatibility_contracts.name: DamagePartModeSelectorContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The part-state initializer must clamp its mode selector into [this+0x1AF4, this+0x1AF8], store it at this+0x1AEC, and write the paired flag/part-type-ID fields at this+0x3670..0x3A2C according to the clamped mode, with the tire-grip multiplier at this+0x49C set to 0.6f for mode 1. A replacement must reproduce the clamp and the per-mode part table selection.

compatibility_contracts.name: ChampionshipThresholdNotifyContract
compatibility_contracts.description: In a championship session (global 0x007C56A4 == 7), when the enable flag at obj+0x4040 is non-zero and at least one threshold entry exists, the loader must compare the player score plus one (obj+0x403C) against the even-indexed entries of the stride-2 array at this+0x164 and call StateChangeNotify(this, 1) on a match.

unresolved: Owner classes for most functions are UnknownObject in the packet; the class grouping here (SessionStateManager, PitCrewMeshObject, UIComponent, TrackEnvironmentSetup, PlayerFileLoader, etc.) is a DERIVED/GUESS proposal, not recovered source.

The semantics of the byte_7CE254 state and the dword_7CE250 counter it resets are not documented; callers suggest session/OSAPI context, and whether the state write is a full byte store or a masked flag update is not decidable from this packet.
The byte_7CE25D flag has only a set-to-1 path here; its consumers are outside this packet.
What StringSplitLoop(2, buildVersionString, 420) detects in the build string is unknown; only its boolean outcome is consumed. The mutex name string global Name resolves to is not visible.
Global hObject (0x007CE2D8) is written by the OS manager but never read inside that function; later consumers are outside this packet.

In 0x004A1D50, the vtable pointer is attributed to this+0xC by the field facts while the pseudocode reads the vtable from the first node; the exact node/container layout is not fully reconciled, and the resource lookup's effect on the traversal is unproven.
For 0x004A1FD0 the packet lists globals flt_59E43C/flt_59E440 as read but the raw source references no globals; both are parked in unresolved_evidence_refs rather than asserted.

The names StringCopyWithReverse / Copies_string_to_local_buffer_with_reversal imply string reversal but no reversal appears in the body; reversal is likely performed by callers 0x004A2A90, 0x004A3910 or 0x004D0110. The role of the constant flag byte at buffer index 64 is unknown.

In 0x004A22D0 the global dword_8AFE64 is recorded as read but never appears in the raw body; dword_8AFE88 is a dead store into an unused local. The roles of a2/a3/a4/a5 and sub_5518A0/sub_551560/WideStringComparisonWalkingLinkedList semantics come only from existing analysis names.

The guard at this+0x64 as a 3D sound-source handle is a fill claim (DERIVED); the raw source only reads the field as a non-zero guard. The FlagFieldBitManipulation argument tuples (1,1,0,0)/(0,0,0,0) meaning is undocumented.
Semantics of the two copied vectors at 0x4C-0x60 are not established; existing analysis suggests a camera/position context from the callers, which is outside this packet's evidence.
Whether sub_54B450 writes the resulting orientation into a member of this (beyond the local matrix) is not visible in the raw source of 0x004A3320; the owning class is unidentified.
sub_4A2220 is invoked by 0x004A3B30 but is absent from the packet's callee list, so its semantics are grounded only in existing analysis (base struct init/cleanup), not packet callee evidence.
0x004A40E0's memset has no callee address evidence reference; the buffer's purpose and owning object are unknown (the Game_Init caller is outside the packet's allowed refs).

The meaning of the obj fields at +0x403C/+0x4040 and of the threshold values in 0x004A6D50 is inferred from context; whether StateChangeNotify can fire multiple times when several thresholds match the same target is unresolved.
The per-node payload free inside the bulk-destructor list walk uses a heap-free helper visible in the raw source but not catalogued in this packet.
The meaning of the four-dword-plus-one-word metadata block appended to the destination filename by 0x004ADD50 is unknown; dword_5C5E60 plays a dual role as format argument and first metadata dword.

The exact environment meaning of the sub_4AE750 arguments (1, 2, 3) and the byte_7CB710 / byte_7CBB0C flag-bit interpretation in 0x004ADE20 are not independently grounded; global 0x008AC368 is in the fact tables but absent from the raw body.

The packet abi label HUD_Display_Frame_Range_Configuration (LEGACY) for 0x004AE750 conflicts with the existing-analysis reading of a vehicle damage/part-state initializer; not resolvable from this packet alone.
sub_568620's body is absent from the packet so its role (stack setup / size guard) is unverified; exact caller expectations for a2 in 0x004B0220 (hard buffer capacity vs copy bound) are not verified.
In 0x004B0390 the semantics of the length limit a3 and the copy primitive sub_587DD0 are not defined; content and role of the default-path global byte_5EA438 depend on its initializer elsewhere.
Semantics of sub_566810 (directory prefix comparison) and sub_4B01B0 (path building) in 0x004B04E0 are inferred from callers, not confirmed.

In 0x004B0540 the packet globals unk_5EC6D0 and unk_8AC368 appear in the fact tables but are absent from the raw decompiled source, parameter a2 is unreferenced, and the identity of the this struct is unknown; equal offsets on unrelated objects are not proof of a shared type.
The five-sub-struct initializer 0x004A48C0 is placed in the physics tire system by its caller, but whether UIComponentCleanup there is a true destructor hook or a generic teardown helper is unknown.
